text:
lisa: Heads up — deploy-bot blocked a publish for `redwood/runtime:2026.03.21-rc2`. It failed provenance TTL annotation and the broker suggested an implicit retag. Can someone from releases or infra confirm policy here?

deploy-bot: [automation] publish aborted: provenance.annotation.ttl missing
```
ERROR: publish denied
reason: provenance.annotation.ttl missing
candidate_action: implicit-retag
image: redwood/runtime:2026.03.21-rc2
digest: sha256:abcd1234efgh5678
```

sam: @lisa thanks — seeing same. Why is implicit-retag considered by default? thought we required explicit retags for prod images. :thinking:

maria: The policy used to be explicit-only for main and prod registries, but a week ago we flipped a config to allow implicit retag in staging queues to reduce CI flakiness. Maybe the flag leaked into the eu-ecr mirror?

ben: I can pull logs — looks like the mirror proxy evaluated `allow_implicit_retag = true` for the eu-ecr shard. That shard should have been false. I suspect a config rollout overlap.

anna: We need to be careful: implicit retag can break provenance expectations and our release notes automation (we use tag -> buildmeta mapping). If we allow automatic retag in this release window we must record the pin digest in the release notes.

lisa: This was on a release candidate that's scheduled for tonight's change window (20:00 UTC). We need a decision: block publish and revert to prior build, or allow manual override with digest pin and add release note.

oncall-jun: @anna what's our rollback criteria if we allow the manual promote and something fails in canary?

anna: Rollback plan: immediate promote of previous pinned digest (from artifacts-db) to the same tag; if canary latency or error rate >2x baseline within 15m, trigger automated rollback. We must ensure the deploy pipeline can accept a pinned-digest promote (it can via /deploybot).

sam: Ops suggestion: allow a one-off manual override for this RC, but require a ticket and a post-mortem. Also set `allow_implicit_retag=false` back on eu-ecr ASAP.

maria: Agree. I've queued a config rollback to the eu-ecr shard (will deploy in ~8m). If someone needs to promote in the meantime do it manually and pin digest.

ben: To promote manually you can run the bot command I used in last rollout: 
```
/deploybot promote --image redwood/runtime:2026.03.21-rc2 \
  --pin-digest sha256:abcd1234efgh5678 \
  --reason "QA approved; temp implicit-retag override" \
  --change-window 2026-03-21T20:00Z
```

lisa: 👍 I'll only do manual promote if Maria confirms the config rollback is in progress. Also will add a line in release notes: "rc2 published with manual digest pin due to provenance TTL annotation; see INF-1234 for follow-up."

anna: Please open INF-1234 for policy clarification + add owners @maria @ben. Make sure release notes include the digest and link to the ticket. I'll review before the change window.

oncall-jun: Also, ensure the canary route uses the pinned digest to avoid image mutation during rollout. I can add a pre-rollout check in the pipeline to validate digest equality.

sam: Noted — I'm adding a quick guard in the pipeline: if digest in registry != pinned digest in artifacts-db, fail deploy.

deploy-bot: [automation] manual override requested by lisa. Waiting for explicit `/deploybot promote` command to proceed.

lisa: Action items: 1) Maria deploys config rollback to disallow implicit-retag on eu-ecr (inflight). 2) Lisa will run `/deploybot promote` pinning the digest if rollout confirmed. 3) Anna will review release notes & sign-off. 4) Sam will add digest guard to pipeline. 5) Ben to file INF-1234 and assign.

maria: Rolled back eu-ecr flag to `allow_implicit_retag=false` in canary (deployed). Monitoring for error spikes.

lisa: Executing manual promote now (pinning digest) — `/deploybot promote` fired.

deploy-bot: [automation] promote accepted. Promotion job id: promote-7721. Pin: sha256:abcd1234efgh5678. Canary target started.

ben: INF-1234 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234 — title: "implicit-retag policy drift: ensure eu-ecr defaults to explicit-only and add release guard" — assigned to @maria.

anna: I'll review release notes and add the rollback criteria to the ticket. Good coordination everyone.

lisa: Closing thread once canary finishes. Expecting final publish success before change window close. :thumbsup:
